story.description: Plain-english user story to turn into an e2e test

featureLib.description: Feature library name (e.g. invoicing-feature-list). Omit to auto-detect from the story.

referenceSpec.description: Path to an existing Playwright spec used as style reference.

model.description: Model alias passed to the nested `claude -p` invocation (e.g. opus, sonnet, haiku).

timeoutMinutes.description: Kill the nested claude process if it runs longer than this many minutes.

skipPermissions.description: Pass --dangerously-skip-permissions to the nested claude so it doesn't prompt for tool approvals. Recommended for demos.

maxRetries.description: Parent-level retry attempts if static or playwright verification fails. Each retry re-invokes claude with the captured error output as context. 0 = no retry (report FAIL after first attempt).
